entity_name: Sahara India Real Estate Corporation Ltd (SIRECL)
violation_summary: Ordered to refund ₹24,400 crore to investors for illegal OFCD fundraising. SEBI found Sahara raised funds from millions through optionally fully convertible debentures without proper disclosure.
Ordered to refund investors alongside SIRECL for illegal OFCD scheme. Total dues later swelled to ₹40,000 crore with interest.
Arrested by UP police for failure to appear before Supreme Court. Sent to Tihar jail. Released on parole May 2016.

entity_name: M/s Sahara India (and its constituent partners)
violation_summary: Barred from raising money from public. SEBI deemed OFCDs illegal public offering disguised as private placement.
Ordered to refund ₹14,000 crore with 15% interest raised through OFCDs.
SEBI cancelled Sahara's mutual fund business licence.
Misuse of client funds and securities. Non-settlement of client accounts. Unsatisfactory financial conditions. Non-submission of data to Exchange. Non-resolution of investor complaints.
Expelled from NSE for misutilization of client funds and securities.
Illegal collective investment scheme. Raised over ₹49,000 crore from 5.8 crore investors. SEBI ordered refund with interest.
Declared defaulter by NSE/BSE for shortfall of client funds and securities.
Improper use of clients' securities. Collection of funds directly from clients in proprietary bank account. Non-segregation of client funds.
